layoutComposition: Headline top-left, diagram block right of centre, two labels placed left and right of the diagram on the same horizontal axis; large empty area bottom third.
typographyHierarchy: Very heavy grotesque caps headline (about 150px) with one accent-coloured numeral; small semi-bold sans labels (about 40px), white on deep green.
colorRelationships: Deep teal ground, pale teal ocean shape, cream planet, single amber moon and numeral as the only warm accent.
imageTreatment: Flat vector shapes, no gradients, no shadows, no texture.
densityPacingTone: Low density: about 10 words on screen; calm, instructional tone.
designRules: One accent colour reserved for the key mark
Labels sit on a shared axis with their callout lines
Headline weight far heavier than label weight
originalityNote: Reference is this project's own frame, used only to exercise the tool; nothing to copy.
